segments.name: Learning services
segments.description: Provides online and offline tutoring services plus educational content and digitalized learning products to students of broad age groups in mainland China.
segments.evidence: As such, the Group concluded that it has one operating segment and one reporting segment.

revenueModel.text: Students and customers pay upfront tutoring fees for online and offline classes, and pay for educational content and digitalized learning products.
revenueModel.evidence: For online and offline tutoring services, tutoring fees are collected in advance.
